steps.text: You might not remember exactly what today means to you.
It would lead you into great danger if you do so.
No.
You must remember.

steps.name: Distant Voice
steps.text: ...Condition... Stable...

steps.name: Distant Voice
steps.text: ...Sorry...

steps.name: Distant Voice
steps.text: For making you suffer again.
Hold my hand tight, Doctor.
Next time, please don't leave me without saying a word.
You wouldn't accept something like this happening again either, right?
Mmm... What's wrong, Dr. {@nickname}?
Why are you looking at me so strangely?

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: *sigh* Where did you manage to learn such a strange language this time around?

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Did you sneakily upload your cognition to some civilization out on the tip of the spiral arm in this round of hibernation?

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Alright, I'd just like to reconfirm whether or not your capability for language has been properly restored.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Don't tell me that you've even forgotten my name just because you've had a big nap.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Come on, say my name again. The database will analyze all of your voice data.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: You recovered rather quickly, {@nickname}.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: But since your body has only just revived, it still hasn't fully acclimated yet.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: So don't make any sudden movements. NX-07 will press you back into bed if you do. Its new orders are rather difficult to rescind, so I'm afraid that my hands are tied.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: You're still on 'Rhodes Island', of course. Our home.

options: What about the others... on Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Just you? Hey, I'm here too.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: ...You really do keep asking this every time.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: It all happened so fast. The damage to the defense array exceeded ninety percent, and with all the extreme environmental damage we received, the repair units were finding it difficult to restore everything in the short time that we had.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Not long after you began your hibernation, many of our colleagues left, one after the other. Everyone wanted to treasure the time they had before the stars fell. I understand how they felt.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Now it's just the two of us left. Of course, AMa-10 is still here as well. She's in good spirits, and still rather lively.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: But don't worry, what's left of Rhodes Island can still maintain its basic functions. We still have some time.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: When you are here with me, {@nickname}, I'm not afraid of the end.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: No matter if our bodies collapse, or if our consciousnesses freeze, or if the laws of the universe invert, I can accept it all with open arms.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: I need only have you by my side.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: You seem rather absent-minded today. Still not fully awake from your dream, {@nickname}?
She takes your hand, pressing it against her cheek.
The touch of her skin is warm. Its corporeality snaps you out of your dream.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: If that's the case, then I would like to know what you dreamed of.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Although I will say that I would prefer if I were in it.
'Terra'.
That land... Catastrophe... Oripathy...
You wandered that land for several years. Felt how real everything was. All too real.
The jubilant cries of the masses still echo in your ears.
The Catastrophes have not yet stifled all hope. Beneath the trauma and the suffering, you can still feel a warmth, enduring, eternal.
It is warm. It is touching. You are surrounded by a gentle crowd of people.
'Rhodes Island'.
You will never forget Rhodes Island.
Rhodes Island healed your scars. Rhodes Island allowed you to have your regrets.
You are still standing with it, aren't you?
You have been to lands covered in ice and snow with them.
Felt the soft sand at the shore with them.
Witnessed how they live.
Witnessed how they die.
They convince you that—
In a unjust land that should have been burnt away, ideals are still worth believing in.
You accompanied those idealists against the surging heat, no matter if it would sear your flesh.
You saw vile empires, and the sorrow of those unable to fight their fate.
You could never forget...
Her.
She has never left you.
They have never left you.
'Doctor...'
'Doctor!'

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Doctor!

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Your mind's wandered off again. It seems you have a penchant for speaking in that alien language.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: And what's wrong with that?

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: We have always had the power to define dreams and reality in our own hands, {@nickname}.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: When our consciousnesses traverse the universe across countless light years, and we participate in sacrificial rituals to a white dwarf in the frozen wastelands, how would we define these experiences?

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Once you return to this body of yours, how would you be able to determine if information that must wait millions of years to be captured is dream or reality?

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Wait, you're not seriously thinking that over, are you?

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: What is it, {@nickname}?

options: Why do I know your name, when we've never met?

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: 'Never met'... So, you've finally noticed.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: I'm happy to hear you say that. It means that you are very close to finding the real me.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: But I can't help but feel a little disappointed.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Because of that minor mishap, your memories... have been damaged beyond repair, and there is nothing that I can do about it.

options: Is this place here... also Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Here... It's 'The unknowable'.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: We made a wish together when we created this place.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: When the last warmth of the stars dissipates, and the weave of time falls apart into chaos, we will let the darkness wrap around the two of us like a blanket.

options: It sounds like you're describing a tomb.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: We will wait until this world and the starry sky above welcome their final moments... Our universe will become an immense tomb of its own.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: There is no hope in any corner of any star in the heavens. Each and every speck of cosmic debris that seems to hold possibility of salvation has long since been found and examined by us.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Every attempt at resistance only ended in its premature destruction. Every exploration only deepened our despair.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: The conclusion was rather simple. Any life formed from ordinary matter is unable to escape. Any knowable technology is unable to prevail over our inevitable end.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: My apologies, {@nickname}.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: It's just that it has been a rather long time since I last had the opportunity to tell you everything I wanted to say.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Intimate? I wouldn't use that term to describe our relationship.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: It belittles all that we have experienced together in the past.

options: I don't remember any of it.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: It's fine, I'm not upset.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Though your mind may not remember, I am sure that in the deepest recesses of your consciousness, deeper than any probe or instrument can reach, there are still traces of me.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: If it were not the case, then why would you allow me to keep holding your hand like this?

options: Did we do this a lot in the past?

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: 'Holding hands'... Yes, we had many different ways to 'hold hands'. Much of the time, we had no need to use any specific part of the body to do it.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: The first time we met, I was flying about an oceanic planet. I used its star as my unchanging anchor, following the line where night met day, flying loop after loop after loop.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: The star died soon after. The ocean below me dissociated in an instant, revealing the bare, dark red skeleton of the planet.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Someone tugged at me from behind, pulling me within a nebula, even more serene than the planet I had just left.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: That one explained to me that although they knew I was most likely not at any risk, there was not enough time to confirm which starfield my original form was in, forcing them to use their ship to salvage my consciousness beacon.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: That was the first time I stepped aboard that ovoid ship. It was not big, but quite agile, and it had already been to countless numbers of stellar systems.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: I took the ship to a planet far from the hustle and bustle. I showed the master of the ship my seaside laboratory, and I stepped closer.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: And just like what we're doing now... We shook hands.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: 'My name is Priestess, a linguist. I am researching the final sound waves emitted by planets as they die. I like quietly spending my time alone, but I also wanted to find someone to explore the universe with.'

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: And now...

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: It's your turn.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: How wonderful. We got to know each other once again.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Oh, right, you seemed somewhat hesitant back then as well. In that age, people were already showing less and less closeness in their associations with others.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Thankfully, we are rather alike. You unselfishly shared your experiences of your travels with me, and even extended me an invitation.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: We leapt across time and space, exploring every nook and cranny of the cosmos. At times we travelled via your ship, but most of the time, we projected our consciousnesses to and from distant worlds.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: You would describe to me the rise and fall of many different civilizations, the rhythm hidden within the birth and death of the stars.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: As our thoughts collided with one another, we would work our way through countless iterations. When we stopped to look back, we realized that we had already far surpassed everyone else.
She flips her hand and shows me a piece of purest crystal.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: A crystal formed from our contentions and collisions, condensing the innumerable truths left behind by the pioneers who watched the cosmos.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: It is truly a beauty.
She places the Originium into your hand lightly, then holds your hand in hers. Together, you are holding this wondrous creation.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Everyone said that I was the one who created Originium and the future both, as though I were akin to a god.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: But I always knew that the true genius was you, {@nickname}.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: You have forgotten... but you shouldn't have.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: As I walked along the path to creating it, I never ceased to follow in your footsteps.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: I feared that there would come a time that I would fall behind you in the field of debate. Feared that you would realize that I was not your equal.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Or no, perhaps you had noticed... Perhaps you had slowed your steps once, waiting for me to catch up to you.

spans.text: noticed... Perhaps you had slowed your steps once, waiting for me to catch up to you.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: But now, I will never know the answer.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: It does, but I have accepted this fact. I would say that actually, it makes me rather happy.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: You still hide many secrets that captivate me.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Besides, from your perspective, I, as I am now, am the same as you in this regard.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Am I wrong, {@nickname}?

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Well, you can continue to find your answers here then.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: This is our shared creation, our shared past, and it conceals our shared secrets.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: You and I need only walk together—

options: Sorry, but I have more pressing concerns now.
I must first confirm some important matters.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: I had wanted to share a few things I had been keeping in your stead with you.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: The things that you once described to me, your ideas and vision that you have completely forgotten.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: I wanted to let you know all that we had accomplished.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Perhaps this would have helped you to remember the past, remember me.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: But I can see what you are thinking, sense what you are feeling.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: You are still plagued by endless doubts, even now.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: 'Amiya', 'Kal'tsit'—

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: I... don't want to put you in a dilemma. I respect your decision.
Her hand touches the darkness—

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: But there is one thing that I am sure of, {@nickname}.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: That when you are truly confused by everything, you will remember: the answers you seek were here all along.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: I will be here.

a.text: <color=#000000>All that you wish for, I am able to grant.</color>
<color=#000000>And once all the grand rhythms and minute pulsations have fallen into silence...</color>
